content.value: Consider a slab of thickness L and constant thermal conductivity k in which energy is (15) generated at a constant rate of $g _ { \circ } w / m ^ { 3 }$ The boundary surface at x = 0 is insulated (adiabatic) and that at $x = L$ dissipates heat by convection with a heat transfer coefficient h into a fluid at a temperature $T _ { \infty } .$ Develop expressions for the temperature $T ( x )$ and the heat flux $q ( x )$ in the slab.
